# archestra_github_pat (Resource)

Stored existing GitHub credential configuration. Applying it registers configuration inside Archestra without provisioning or contacting GitHub. Credential input is required for creation, preserved when omitted, and write-only on the API; imports adopt metadata without recovering it. Deletion revokes the Archestra registration and is rejected while synchronized resources still reference it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "github_pat" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "archestra_github_pat" "example" {
  name  = "existing-source-token"
  token = var.github_pat
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Credential display name.

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Write-only credential; changing it rotates the stored value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Stored configuration UUID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import archestra_github_pat.example <uuid>
```
